title: The master chain, final limiter and loudness target carry over to the main track
description:
As a producer, I want the master chain and the loudness target in the set, so that the set plays as loud as the render.

```gherkin
Feature: The master in the set
  Scenario: The master's effects and limiter
    Given the score's master has "eq lowcut 30", "comp 2:1 -12dB" and "limit -1dB"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the main track's devices are "EQ Eight", "Compressor", "Limiter" and a "Utility"
    And the Limiter's ceiling is -1 dB

  Scenario: The master always ends in a limiter
    Given the score's master has no limiter
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the main track has a Limiter with a ceiling of -1 dB

  Scenario: The loudness target becomes a make-up gain
    Given the score's master has "loudness -14LUFS"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the main track's Utility gain is the make-up gain "apricity render" reports for the score

  Scenario: Skipping the loudness measurement
    When I export the score as a DAW set with "--no-measure"
    Then the export does not render the score
    And the main track's Utility gain is 0 dB
    And the export warns that the loudness target was not applied
```

Note: the order of the limiter and the make-up gain follows the engine's master (`crates/apricity-engine/src/master.rs`).
